# Dataspryva Actor documentation

> Reference pages and API tutorials for the 128 public Apify Actors published by Dataspryva. Every page is generated from the Actor's published README, input schema, output definitions and Store pricing, and regenerated when the published build changes. Prices are the published pay-per-event prices; runs happen on Apify.

- Catalog: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/
- Sites A to Z: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/sites/
- Topics: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/topics/
- Guides: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/
- Machine-readable index: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors.json
- Publisher on Apify: https://apify.com/dataspryva

## AI

- [Decrypt Crypto News Finder by Category & Keyword](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/decrypt-crypto-news-finder-by-category-and-keyword/): Search Decrypt's crypto, Web3, and AI news by keyword or category, or look up specific articles, for full article text, authors, tags, mentioned coins, and featured images. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/decrypt-crypto-news-finder-by-category-and-keyword/
- [Google Scholar Paper & Citation Search Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/google-scholar-paper-and-citation-search-scraper/): Search Google Scholar by keyword and get structured records for papers and citations, with author, venue, year, citation counts, and links to PDFs and related work. Filter by year range, document format, and article type. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/google-scholar-paper-and-citation-search-scraper/
- [Skool Community Directory, Pricing & Member Finder](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/skool-community-directory-pricing-and-member/): Browse Skool's public community directory by category, pull pricing and member-count details for communities you already know, and list top members visible on a public community page. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/skool-community-directory-pricing-and-member/

## Automation

- [Instagram Posts & Reels Data Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/instagram-posts-and-reels-data-scraper/): Scrape public Instagram posts, Reels, IGTV and carousels from a list of links, no login. Get caption, hashtags, author, photo and video links, likes, comments, video plays, location and music. Export to Excel, CSV or JSON. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/instagram-posts-and-reels-data-scraper/
